items.headline: Price move coincides with 2 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 6603.32/MWh on 2026-05-22, same day as: BELLARY TPS unit 3: 700.0 MW affected; ADANI POWER unit 2: 600.0 MW affected (~1300 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
